disclaimer: Preliminary estimate, subject to measurement and inspection. These ranges are provisional local planning benchmarks, not VIPRO quotes. Vlad has not approved a price list.

screen_recoat.label: Screen and recoat
screen_recoat.scope: Existing hardwood floor, screen and recoat package (alternative to full sanding).
screen_recoat.notes: Alternative package to full sanding and refinish. Do not add sanding or a second finish when this package is selected.

full_sand_natural.label: Full sanding and natural/clear refinish
full_sand_natural.scope: Existing hardwood floor, full sand and natural/clear finish package.
full_sand_natural.notes: Alternative to screen/recoat and to stained full refinish. Sanding and finish are included; do not add them again.

full_sand_stained.label: Full sanding and stained refinish
full_sand_stained.scope: Existing hardwood floor, full sand, stain, and finish package.
full_sand_stained.notes: Alternative to screen/recoat and to natural full refinish. Stain color selection does not change this range unless a configured surcharge exists.

prefinished_labor_only.label: Prefinished hardwood installation labor only
prefinished_labor_only.scope: Labor to install prefinished hardwood. Excludes flooring material and preparation.
prefinished_labor_only.notes: Use only in itemized mode. Never add this labor on top of an installed package.

engineered_installed.label: Engineered hardwood installed
engineered_installed.scope: Installed package for engineered hardwood, net work area.
inclusions: Engineered hardwood material of a standard grade implied by the benchmark
exclusions: Preparation and extras that the package does not list
engineered_installed.notes: Calculation mode A: area × all-in package rate. Do not add separate installation labor.

solid_installed_site_finished.label: Solid hardwood installed and site-finished
solid_installed_site_finished.scope: Installed package that includes installation and on-site sanding/finishing for new solid hardwood.
inclusions: Solid hardwood of a standard grade implied by the benchmark
solid_installed_site_finished.notes: This package includes both installation and site finishing. Do not add those steps again unless a different package is selected.

ceramic_porcelain_floor_tile_installed.label: Standard ceramic/porcelain floor tile installed
ceramic_porcelain_floor_tile_installed.scope: Installed package for standard ceramic or porcelain floor tile, floor area only.
inclusions: Standard ceramic or porcelain floor tile
ceramic_porcelain_floor_tile_installed.notes: Applies to floor area, not shower or wall area.

general_flooring_removal.label: General flooring removal
general_flooring_removal.scope: Per square foot of removed area, not automatically the whole floor.
inclusions: Removal of existing flooring of a typical assembly
general_flooring_removal.notes: Charge the stated removal area only.

tile_demolition.label: Tile demolition
tile_demolition.scope: Per square foot of demolished tile. Difficult assemblies require inspection.
tile_demolition.notes: Priced from $3.50 per sq ft. No high rate is published; difficult assemblies require inspection. Do not invent a high figure.

subfloor_repair_leveling.label: Subfloor repair or leveling
subfloor_repair_leveling.scope: Per square foot of the actual affected area, subject to condition, depth and method.
subfloor_repair_leveling.notes: Uses the stated affected area, not the whole floor. Condition, depth and method can change the outcome.

parquet.label: Parquet
parquet.scope: Parquet flooring. No approved or provisional installed rate was provided.
parquet.notes: Requires assessment unless an admin rate is entered. No surcharge was invented.

herringbone.label: Herringbone or intricate pattern
herringbone.scope: Herringbone, chevron, or other intricate patterns.
herringbone.notes: Requires assessment unless an admin rate is entered. Waste percent may still apply to material quantity in itemized mode.

stairs.label: Stairs
stairs.scope: Stair work, per flight or item as configured.
stairs.notes: No stair price was provided. Requires assessment unless an admin rate is entered.

shower_waterproofing.label: Shower waterproofing
shower_waterproofing.scope: Shower waterproofing and related wet-area work.
shower_waterproofing.notes: No shower waterproofing price was provided.

premium_materials.label: Premium materials
premium_materials.scope: Premium material upgrade beyond the package benchmark.

major_repairs.label: Major repairs
major_repairs.scope: Major repairs beyond typical subfloor leveling.

mobilization.label: Mobilization
mobilization.scope: Mobilization / trip charge applied once to its defined scope, not per room.
mobilization.notes: No separate mobilization amount was provided. See the small-job minimum placeholder.

straight.notes: Default waste for straight layouts: 7–10%. Editable. Used for material order quantity, not labor.

diagonalHerringbone.notes: Default waste for diagonal or herringbone layouts: 12–15%. Editable.

smallJob.label: Small-job minimum / mobilization (unapproved placeholder)
smallJob.scope: Applied once to the selected package scope when the package subtotal is below this amount. Not applied automatically per room.
smallJob.notes: UNAPPROVED PLACEHOLDER — Vlad did not provide a minimum. This figure exists so the formula can be tested and edited. It is not a VIPRO rate. Do not treat it as an approved price.

contingency.notes: Optional contingency. Disabled until an approved percent is entered. Unknown is not treated as 0%.

tax.provider: Washington Department of Revenue address-based sales tax rate lookup
tax.note: WA sales tax is destination-specific. A 5-digit ZIP can contain more than one rate (DOR result code 5). Do not hard-code a Seattle rate. Residential construction can be taxable including labor; confirm taxability. Use a street address for a confirmed rate, or mark tax unconfirmed.
